description: Move picks from one of the person's lists to another, keeping each pick's note, details and history. They go to the end of the destination in the order given. Pass the source list's `revision` from list_items; if it changed since, nothing moves. Changes the working versions only; readers keep seeing the last approved versions. On a live destination, call review_items and confirm_items for the moved picks after the person's approval. Updating the source's published version requires separate owner approval. Private lists stay private. An archived list can't take picks until it is unarchived.

from.description: The list the picks are in now.

itemIds.description: Item ids from list_items on the `from` list.

revision.description: The `revision` list_items returned for the `from` list.

to.description: The list to move them to.

toRevision.description: Optional: the destination revision, to refuse the move if it changed too.

name: move_items
title: Move picks to another list
